data.answer: Beyond Snack is an Indian snack food company specializing in authentic Kerala banana chips available in various flavors. The company was born in Kerala, sourcing Nendran bananas directly from farmers and crafting chips in a women-led facility. Beyond Snack's products have gained a global presence, being exported to countries such as the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Mauritius, Qatar, and Kuwait. The company offers a variety of flavors including Original Style, Peri Peri, Sour Cream Onion & Parsley, Salt & Black Pepper, Desi Masala, and Hot & Sweet Chilli. The products are prepared using superior quality raw materials while maintaining top-notch standards of hygiene.

We're proud of where we come from and the hands that make us. As we grow, our mission stays the same: to become the most loved snack brand in the world, one honest, delicious bite at a time.

results.content:
The pack says these are Kerala Banana Chips made using Nendran, a variety associated with Kerala. The brand describes Nendran as a tall, strong banana with thick flesh, calling it the king of bananas. That sounds like a great story, but the real test begins when we open the packet.

The front highlights “Super Thin Chips” and “For Superior Snacking.” It also says Non GMO and Naturally Gluten Free. The net weight is 150 grams and the MRP is ₹116, inclusive of taxes. The pack was manufactured on 15 July 2026 and the use-by date is 14 January 2027.

There is also an interesting packaging detail: the packet is filled with nitrogen to help keep the product fresh. That is something I always like to see with crispy snacks because exposure to air and moisture can affect the crunch. [...] Now let’s taste them.

The first thing I notice is the crunch. These chips are genuinely thin and crisp, and the texture is quite satisfying. The flavour is straightforward: you get the natural banana-chip taste, followed by the savoury saltiness and the fried character from the oil.
